import itertools
from pysat.solvers import Glucose3

# Vertices 0-6
vertices = list(range(7))
edges = list(itertools.combinations(vertices, 2))
edge_index = {e: i+1 for i, e in enumerate(edges)}  # 1-based for SAT

# Create solver
solver = Glucose3()

# For each triangle, add clauses to prevent all 0 or all 1
for triple in itertools.combinations(vertices, 3):
    e1 = tuple(sorted([triple[0], triple[1]]))
    e2 = tuple(sorted([triple[0], triple[2]]))
    e3 = tuple(sorted([triple[1], triple[2]]))
    v1 = edge_index[e1]
    v2 = edge_index[e2]
    v3 = edge_index[e3]
    # Not all false (0): at least one true
    solver.add_clause([v1, v2, v3])
    # Not all true (1): at least one false
    solver.add_clause([-v1, -v2, -v3])

# Solve
result = solver.solve()
print(result)
if result:
    model = solver.get_model()
    colors = [1 if x > 0 else 0 for x in model[:21]]
    print(colors)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
